smg.text: Very hot. Cloudy apart from sunny periods. A few thundery showers later. Force 3 to 4 west to northwesterly winds, becoming force 5 to 6 with gusts.
Cloudy. Showers, heavy at times. Occasional thunderstorms. Force 5 to 6 west to southwesterly winds, occasionally force 7 with gusts.
Mainly cloudy. A few thundery showers. Force 4 to 5 south to southwesterly winds with gusts.
Mainly cloudy. Occasional showers. A few thunderstorms. Force 3 to 4 east to southeasterly winds with gusts.
Cloudy. Showers. Occasional thunderstorms. Force 4 to 5 south to southeasterly winds with gusts.
